evidence.quote: Applicants can register for the admission test (art. 4 and 5) on the Apply@polito platform starting from Thursday 22nd January 2025.
Friday 22nd May 2026 for non-EU applicants residing abroad and requiring visa;

If you are an international student living abroad and applying for a visa, you must submit the pre-enrollment application to obtain a study visa and enrol at Politecnico di Torino exclusively through the UNIVERSITALY portal.
English-taught programmes English Level B2 or above
1) a secondary high school diploma (level 4 EQF) earned after at least 12 years of school attendance

note.fr: Test d'admission obligatoire (test TIL-I) : réussir le test d'admission ou fournir un score SAT. Le score minimum est de 30/100 ; un score d'au moins 60/100 garantit l'admission.
note.en: Mandatory admission test (TIL-I test): pass the admission test or submit a SAT score. Minimum score is 30/100; a score of at least 60/100 guarantees admission.

evidence.quote: Applicants must have a minimum score of 650 points in each of the two test sections (art.12, par.1).

notes: Tuition left out: the only figures found (Art. 3, Regolamento contribuzione 2026/2027) give a minimum of 600,00 € and a maximum of 3.600,00 € proportioned to the GDP at purchasing power parity of the student's country of citizenship; no quote names Morocco and no quote ties this programme to a fee group, so the fallback range was not used. Deadlines: only the 2026/27 call was used; the Call also lists later TIL-I sessions and a 30th June 2026 pre-enrolment deadline on Universitaly. Other rounds exist for EU applicants and for the 5th session.
